summary.text: Brenda Lawrence is the Republican candidate for South Dakota State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat where she faces Erik Muckey (D).
She was the Republican nominee for the same district in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brenda Lawrence ran for South Dakota State Senate District 15 in 2022, when she lost to incumbent Reynold Nesiba (D) with 47.2 percent of the vote.
She ran for the seat again in 2024 and lost to Jamie Smith (D), receiving 47.6 percent.
